reddit_quotes: I've used Lodge Enameled for 24 months. Not worth the premium.
Lodge Enameled is the kind of thing you don't appreciate until you've used the cheap alternative and regretted it.
The Lodge Enameled community is split, but the people who actually own them tend to keep them.
detractor_quote: I returned my Lodge Enameled after two weeks. The marketing is better than the product.
